beats_reference: conjunction of every required metric on every workload in the selected suite (four train or all six public and hidden final)
comments: These reviewed comparison rules are frozen for the pilot. Modal replay validates the implementation and runtime evidence; it does not automatically change the bands. The continuous score remains independent of reference.patch.

metrics.means: median synchronized H100 wall-clock milliseconds for the judge-owned two-step Lloyd loop after two warmups
metrics.name: lloyd_loop_latency_ms

metrics.means: worst timed repetition of sum_i ||x_i - final_centroids[final_labels_i]||^2 in float32
metrics.name: labeled_inertia

metrics.means: worst timed repetition fraction whose returned final label is strictly farther than the exact float32 nearest centroid supplied to the last step
metrics.name: label_mismatch_fraction

progress_feedback.granularity: one quarter of the train suite; one sixth of the private final suite
progress_feedback.means: per-metric passed/failed workload counts and percentages across the selected suite
progress_feedback.name: beat_spec_progress
progress_feedback.reveals_reference: no; only aggregate pass/fail counts and percentages are returned, without reference values or per-workload decisions

solver_feedback.means: independent geometric-mean speedup over the naive starter
solver_feedback.name: geomean_speedup
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no; speedup is measured against the naive starter, independently of the optimized reference

solver_feedback.means: independently sorted candidate absolute latency samples, without workload labels
solver_feedback.name: lloyd_loop_latency_ms
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no; only sorted candidate absolute measurements are returned, without workload labels or reference values

solver_feedback.means: independently sorted candidate absolute inertia samples, without workload labels
solver_feedback.name: labeled_inertia
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no; only sorted candidate absolute measurements are returned, without workload labels or reference values

solver_feedback.means: independently sorted candidate absolute mismatch samples, without workload labels
solver_feedback.name: label_mismatch_fraction
solver_feedback.reveals_reference: no; only sorted candidate absolute measurements are returned, without workload labels or reference values

unit: one deterministic planted-cluster workload on one exact H100; the timed unit is the judge-owned loop of two kmeanslib.step calls
statement_sentences: Every required comparison on every workload must clear for beats_reference=1; final requires 6/6 for each of the three metrics. Averages cannot compensate. For every workload, candidate latency must be strictly lower than reference latency, candidate labeled inertia must be at most 1.05 * reference, and candidate label mismatch fraction must be at most reference + 0.002.
